rows.statement: theorem positivity_implies_RH : (∀ n : ℕ, 0 ≤ (taylorCoeff riemannXi n).re) → (∀ s : ℂ, riemannZeta s = 0 → (0 < s.re ∧ s.re < 1) → s.re = 1/2)
rows.conclusion: (∀ s : ℂ, riemannZeta s = 0 → (0 < s.re ∧ s.re < 1) → s.re = 1/2)

bridge.statement: theorem rh_equiv_mathlib : RiemannHypothesis ↔ (∀ s : ℂ, riemannZeta s = 0 → (0 < s.re ∧ s.re < 1) → s.re = 1 / 2)
